Show system status and health summary.

This command displays:
  - Project information
  - Current priority plan
  - System health (from system check)
  - Recent activity
  - Storage backend information

  Basic status
  zqk system status
  Verbose status with detailed information
  zqk system status --verbose

Usage:
  zqk system status [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
